rootCause.what: The proposal call now offers two tools (submit plus the selection tool). The transport assertion required exactly one and threw DeepSeekStrictToolConfigurationError.
rootCause.statusIsLocal: DeepSeekStrictToolConfigurationError.status = 422 is a local constant, so the server log's providerStatus:422 does not mean DeepSeek rejected anything. The ordinal 2 request never left the machine and has no usage.

meterNote: Two calls are counted but only ordinal 1 reached the API (21215 in / 50 out). Ordinal 2 has no usage and is charged at the conservative upper bound, which is why the CNY figure exceeds round75's four real calls.

pricing.note: Unknown usage charged at the conservative upper bound. Computed from the saved verified tariff, not a provider invoice.

followUpProbe.question: Does the strict-tool beta endpoint accept two strict tools at all?
followUpProbe.request: POST https://api.deepseek.com/beta/chat/completions, deepseek-v4-flash, two strict:true function tools, tool_choice required, parallel_tool_calls false
followUpProbe.conclusion: The provider accepts two strict tools and the model selected the second and filled it. The one-tool rule was ours, not the provider's, and it was wrong for this use.
